_README: Live production error digests fed into scheduled Operations runs. OPTIONAL and off by default.
Copy to data/ops-signals.json (gitignored) and replace the placeholders, or set the OPS_SIGNALS
env var to this same JSON object (env wins over the file).
Each top-level key is a PROJECT directory name under WORKSPACES_ROOT — the same name a task targets.
For each project, PlumiChat fetches a REDACTED error digest from <baseUrl><path>, server-side, using
the header 'X-API-Key: <apiKey>', and injects it into that project's scheduled runs as the freshest
The apiKey never enters a prompt, a tool call, or the agent's view — it is used by the server only.
Your endpoint is responsible for redaction: whatever it returns goes into the prompt, so it must not
Leave a placeholder containing PASTE_ to keep a project disabled. Unconfigured projects run normally.
Keys starting with '_' are ignored — they are never treated as a project.
